claims.statement: The guide aims to give CHWs the knowledge and skills to provide home-based care to people living with HIV/AIDS in their communities.
claims.quote: This curriculum aims to provide CHWs with the knowledge and skills necessary to provide CHBC to PLWHA in their communities.
claims.locator: Notes to the Trainer: Introduction to the Curriculum
claims.reason: every citation quotes the source exactly

claims.statement: The guide has core units, a practicum, and advanced units meant for use after the core areas are covered.
claims.quote: The Trainer’s Guide is divided into 13 core units, a practicum, and 5 advanced units that contain additional information that CHWs might find useful after they have covered the core areas.
claims.locator: Notes to the Trainer: Introduction to the Curriculum
claims.reason: every citation quotes the source exactly

claims.statement: Home-based care does not replace hospital care.
claims.quote: CHBC is not a replacement for hospital care.
claims.reason: every citation quotes the source exactly

claims.statement: Training groups should be limited to 15-20 participants so there is a good trainer ratio and time for skills practice.
claims.quote: CHBC trainings should be limited to 15-20 participants to ensure a good trainer-participant ratio and adequate time for skills practice.
claims.locator: Notes to the Trainer: Training and Supervision of Community Health Workers
claims.reason: every citation quotes the source exactly

claims.statement: CHW selection must avoid favouritism and patronage.
claims.quote: Care should be taken to avoid favoritism or patronage (e.g., getting the job because you are related to or friends with the project manager).
claims.locator: Notes to the Trainer: CHW Selection Process
claims.reason: every citation quotes the source exactly

claims.statement: Clients can refuse to take part in the practicum, and refusing must not affect the care they already receive.
claims.quote: Clients should understand that they can refuse to participate in the practicum and that it will not affect the care that they are already receiving.
claims.locator: Notes to the Trainer: More About the CHBC Practicum, Evaluation, and Certification
